title: Horsebit Loafers - Dark Brown Calf
description:
Named Best All-American Horsebit Loafer by GQ, this timeless style is handcrafted in Maine using genuine handsewn moccasin construction. Made from hand-burnished Italian calfskin and lined in leather for comfort and structure, it’s finished with a watertight, oil-treated leather outsole and antique brass snaffle bit from Japan.

A classic of Ivy style—versatile, refined, and built to last.Genuine handsewn moccasin construction. Made in Maine, USA with heritage materials from domestic and international sources.
